Includes exact membership and coverage; subset mu, I2, Q, k, computed DL tau2, sampled SE; all exported numerical summaries; exact summary headings/labels/values; sampling control visibility; exact model option labels/selection and requested draw-control value; plotted count and every default SVG coordinate; exact ordered axis/tick labels; empty error/status messages (plot, sampling, axis) and exact default axis-control labels/values during replay; every other visible text node and aria-label/title of the page template (incl. benchmark selector) outside the validation panel, exactly; draft banner absent or exact.
